title: Manyhands JSON v1 context mutation data
description: The data of a context prepare envelope that provisioned a work context or found one: the branch and the worktree an item is edited in. It accompanies success and discovery_pending, the one partial result, in which the context is there and only the index hand-off is owed. A request that is refused carries no data. It never holds a body, a source or a draft.

id.description: The ID of the item the context is for.

kind.description: The item's kind: ticket or document.

worktree.description: The context's worktree, as an absolute path.

created.description: Whether this request made the context. False when it was there already, made by an earlier request.
